description: Concept: one card for transit and campus

backFields.label: WHAT THIS IS
backFields.value: A visual mock-up of one phone credential covering both public transport tag-on/tag-off and campus building access. It is not a real, working transit or access card — Auckland Transport and MIT would each need to provision it directly for that to be possible.

backFields.label: WORKING DEMO
backFields.value: The tag-on/tag-off fare logic and campus access rules this concept represents run for real in this project's Android (card) and iOS (reader) apps, communicating over a custom NFC protocol with AID F04B414C4953434F5045. Tap the two apps together to see it work.

backFields.label: STATUS
backFields.value: Concept only — no live balance or access changes happen when this pass is tapped.

barcodes.altText: Concept demo — not a real fare/access credential
